name: LangMem
problem_solved: AI agents often fail to learn from prior conversations and ask the same questions again in each new session.
what_it_does: Provides long-term memory, memory extraction, prompt optimization, and LangGraph storage integration for agents.
sample_project: Personal AI career coach that remembers user goals, preferred roles, rejected companies, and interview feedback.
before_after_angle: Before: the chatbot starts from scratch every time. After: the agent uses previous conversations to provide more personalized answers.

name: Mem0
problem_solved: LLM apps often lack persistent user context and personalization.
what_it_does: Works as a universal memory layer that stores and retrieves user, agent, and session memory.
sample_project: Customer support assistant that remembers customer preferences, prior tickets, and unresolved issues.
before_after_angle: Before: the support bot treats every ticket separately. After: the bot responds with better context from customer history.

name: Zep
problem_solved: Enterprise agents struggle to manage dynamic business context and conversation history at scale.
what_it_does: Provides governed, low-latency context retrieval through a temporal knowledge graph-based memory layer.
sample_project: Enterprise account assistant that tracks relationship changes, meetings, objections, and next actions.
before_after_angle: Before: CRM notes remain plain text. After: the agent uses a temporal relationship graph.

name: Graphiti
problem_solved: RAG systems often require batch knowledge graph rebuilds whenever information changes.
what_it_does: Builds real-time temporal context graphs and incrementally stores new facts and relationship changes.
sample_project: Meeting intelligence system that tracks how project decisions change over time.
before_after_angle: Before: recent meeting notes are lost inside static RAG. After: the agent can inspect decision timelines and relationship changes.

name: Letta
problem_solved: Agents struggle to manage long-term behavior, core memory, and archival memory.
what_it_does: Provides a platform for building stateful agents with memory blocks, archival memory, and self-improving behavior.
sample_project: Coding mentor agent that remembers user's code style, weak areas, and learning plan.
before_after_angle: Before: the coding assistant gives generic advice. After: it mentors based on the user's history.

name: Supermemory
problem_solved: Building memory, user profiles, and RAG pipelines separately adds operational overhead to AI apps.
what_it_does: Provides ingestion, semantic search, user profiling, and context management through a memory API.
sample_project: Personal knowledge assistant that remembers articles, notes, and user interests.
before_after_angle: Before: bookmark search remains keyword-based. After: the assistant responds with user memory and semantic context.

name: Cognee
problem_solved: Agents often miss relationships between documents, decisions, and workflows.
what_it_does: Turns structured and unstructured data into queryable context using embeddings and graph memory.
sample_project: Internal policy assistant that connects policies, exceptions, owners, and change history.
before_after_angle: Before: RAG only finds similar chunks. After: the agent reasons through a relationship graph.

name: Agno
problem_solved: Prototype agents are difficult to run, trace, schedule, and manage as production services.
what_it_does: Provides an agent platform with RBAC, tracing, scheduling, memory, human review loops, and a control plane.
sample_project: Data analyst agent that runs scheduled business KPI analysis and stores traces.
before_after_angle: Before: the notebook demo runs manually. After: it runs as a scheduled, traceable agent service.

name: Browser Use
problem_solved: AI agents struggle to click, fill forms, navigate, and extract information from real websites.
what_it_does: Makes websites accessible to AI agents and controls browser automation through natural language and tools.
sample_project: Job search agent that visits job boards, extracts matching roles, and creates a shortlist.
before_after_angle: Before: job search happens manually across browser tabs. After: a browser agent automates repetitive browsing.

name: Stagehand
problem_solved: Selenium and Playwright selectors are brittle when high-level AI browser actions are needed.
what_it_does: Provides natural language plus code-based browser automation through act, extract, observe, and agent primitives.
sample_project: Competitor pricing monitor that navigates product pages and extracts structured prices.
before_after_angle: Before: the scraper breaks when CSS selectors change. After: AI-assisted extraction is more flexible.

name: BAML
problem_solved: Managing prompts as strings creates versioning and structured output reliability problems.
what_it_does: Turns prompt engineering into schema engineering through a DSL for reliable LLM functions.
sample_project: PDF invoice extraction workflow with typed LLM functions and testable schemas.
before_after_angle: Before: prompts are scattered inside application code. After: BAML functions make prompts and schemas maintainable.

name: Guardrails AI
problem_solved: LLM apps need protection against input/output risks, PII leakage, unsafe content, and malformed structured data.
what_it_does: Provides input/output guards, validators, risk detection, and structured data validation.
sample_project: Healthcare intake assistant with PII checks, safety filters, and structured output validation.
before_after_angle: Before: the bot can return sensitive data without checks. After: guards block and validate risky input/output.

name: ModelScope ms-swift
problem_solved: Teams need one CLI and Web UI to manage many model families and tuning methods.
what_it_does: Supports LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, LoRA+, LongLoRA, LoRA-GA, ReFT, RS-LoRA, and multimodal fine-tuning workflows.
sample_project: Compare LoRA, DoRA, and LongLoRA on the same dataset.
before_after_angle: Before: only one LoRA adapter is tested. After: multiple adapter methods are compared across accuracy, latency, and memory.

name: Axolotl
problem_solved: Complex LoRA/QLoRA, DPO, multimodal, and MoE fine-tuning configurations are hard to manage in a production-like way.
what_it_does: Provides a configuration-first training stack for advanced LLM fine-tuning workflows.
sample_project: Run a LoRA fine-tuning experiment focused only on expert weights in a MoE model.
before_after_angle: Before: MoE fine-tuning is expensive in VRAM. After: expert-focused LoRA can provide cheaper adaptation.

name: AdapterHub Adapters
problem_solved: Teams need a modular way to train and reuse adapters across domains and tasks.
what_it_does: Provides adapter composition, adapter merging, QLoRA support, and modular transfer learning workflows.
sample_project: Build a concept with finance, support, and Azerbaijani tone adapters for one base model.
before_after_angle: Before: each task needs a separate model. After: modular adapters provide task-specific behavior.

name: m-LoRA
problem_solved: Training many domain adapters can create GPU utilization and latency problems.
what_it_does: Focuses on fine-tuning many LoRA/QLoRA adapters at the same time on one base model.
sample_project: Train three adapters for the same base model: legal, finance, and customer support.
before_after_angle: Before: adapters are trained one by one. After: multi-LoRA scheduling can be compared by throughput.

name: LoRAX
problem_solved: Deploying a separate endpoint for every fine-tuned model is expensive.
what_it_does: Serves many LoRA adapters on a shared base model with dynamic adapter loading and routing.
sample_project: Train three LoRA adapters and build a dynamic adapter routing demo with LoRAX.
before_after_angle: Before: every adapter needs a separate endpoint. After: one shared base model can dynamically load adapters.

name: SimpleTuner
problem_solved: Image and video generation models need production-like LoRA training and job orchestration.
what_it_does: Provides a training toolkit for diffusion model fine-tuning, including FLUX, SDXL, SD3, and video generation models.
sample_project: Train a brand-style LoRA that teaches a FLUX or SDXL model a consistent product visual identity.
before_after_angle: Before: the image model does not preserve brand style. After: LoRA produces more consistent brand visuals.

name: Honcho
problem_solved: Agents may store memory but fail to update a useful user model through reasoning.
what_it_does: Provides a reasoning memory layer for stateful agents across people, projects, sessions, and ideas.
sample_project: Personal productivity assistant that learns communication style and project priorities.
before_after_angle: Before: the assistant behaves like a reminder tool. After: it makes proactive suggestions based on a user model.

name: memU
problem_solved: Proactive 24/7 agents often fail to structure user routines and long-term preferences.
what_it_does: Extracts structured memory from multimodal inputs and creates a hierarchical memory file system.
sample_project: Proactive daily assistant that remembers routines, documents, images, and recurring preferences.
before_after_angle: Before: the assistant only responds when asked. After: it offers proactive help based on learned routines.

name: Metarank
problem_solved: Search and listing pages often show the same results to every user.
what_it_does: Personalizes product listings, articles, search results, and recommendations through a low-code learning-to-rank service.
sample_project: Personalized product search reranker using clicks, views, and purchases.
before_after_angle: Before: search results are ordered by static relevance. After: ranking is personalized using user behavior.

name: Gorse
problem_solved: Recommendation backends for products or content are often written from scratch.
what_it_does: Provides a Go-based open-source recommender engine using users, items, and feedback.
sample_project: GitHub repository recommender based on stars, topics, and user interactions.
before_after_angle: Before: trending repositories are the same for everyone. After: users get personalized repository lists based on interests.

name: RecBole
problem_solved: Recommendation algorithms need a unified experiment framework for fair comparison.
what_it_does: Provides a PyTorch-based framework for 100+ recommendation models and multiple recommendation tasks.
sample_project: Compare sequential vs collaborative filtering models on e-commerce click data.
before_after_angle: Before: recommendations are random or trend-based. After: RecBole produces behavior-based top-N recommendations.

name: Cornac
problem_solved: It is difficult to include text, image, and social features in recommendation models.
what_it_does: Provides a comparative framework for multimodal recommender systems.
sample_project: Fashion recommender using product images, descriptions, and user interactions.
before_after_angle: Before: recommendations only use interaction data. After: image and text metadata improve cold-start recommendations.

name: Vespa
problem_solved: Search, vector retrieval, and ranking personalization are often built in separate systems.
what_it_does: Provides a scalable engine for search, vector search, tensor ranking, and recommendation serving.
sample_project: Personalized news search with user embeddings and query-time ranking features.
before_after_angle: Before: search only uses query relevance. After: user embeddings and behavior influence the ranking score.

name: promptfoo
problem_solved: Prompt and model comparisons are often not cost-aware.
what_it_does: Provides an open-source LLM evaluation framework for prompts, models, RAG, and agents with caching plus cost/token reporting workflows.
sample_project: Build an accuracy, latency, and cost table for 20 prompt variants.
before_after_angle: Before: prompt selection is manual. After: promptfoo provides a token-aware evaluation matrix.

name: garak
problem_solved: LLM applications are not systematically tested for prompt injection, jailbreaks, leakage, and hallucination weaknesses.
what_it_does: Provides an NVIDIA-backed open-source LLM vulnerability scanner with probes for prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks, and related risks.
sample_project: Run garak prompt injection probes against my own chatbot endpoint.
before_after_angle: Before: security is checked with manual prompts. After: garak reports vulnerable categories.

name: Dify
problem_solved: LLM apps, RAG pipelines, workflows, agents, and observability are often built separately.
what_it_does: Provides an open-source LLM app platform with knowledge bases, RAG, agent workflows, model management, and observability.
sample_project: Internal company policy assistant with uploaded PDFs, workflow routing, and citation-backed answers.
before_after_angle: Before: employees search policy PDFs manually. After: Dify knowledge base answers with citations and workflow actions.

name: RAGFlow
problem_solved: Complex PDFs, tables, scanned documents, and formatted reports do not work well with basic chunking.
what_it_does: Provides a deep document understanding-based open-source RAG engine with citations, parsing, and enterprise RAG workflows.
sample_project: Financial report QA system that answers from PDFs with tables and citations.
before_after_angle: Before: naive PDF chunking loses tables and layout. After: RAGFlow gives citation-backed answers from complex documents.

name: Quivr
problem_solved: Personal and team knowledge bases need a fast, opinionated RAG core.
what_it_does: Provides a second brain-style RAG platform/core with any-file ingestion, custom RAG, tools, and internet search support.
sample_project: Personal research knowledge base over PDFs, notes, and web articles.
before_after_angle: Before: notes and papers are searched by filename. After: Quivr retrieves semantically relevant knowledge.

name: MinerU
problem_solved: Scientific PDFs, formulas, tables and complex page layouts are hard to extract for KBs.
what_it_does: Open-source document extraction/conversion toolkit for PDFs and complex layouts.
sample_project: Academic paper KB that preserves formulas, tables and page structure.
before_after_angle: Before: formula/table evidence is lost. After: MinerU improves structured paper ingestion.

name: RTP-LLM
problem_solved: Industrial-scale LLM serving needs a production-proven, high-performance engine.
what_it_does: Provides an Alibaba open-source LLM inference acceleration engine with batching, GPU memory management, prefill/decode separation, and multi-hardware support.
sample_project: High-throughput Qwen serving benchmark with RTP-LLM.
before_after_angle: Before: a generic server sees higher latency under heavy load. After: RTP-LLM demonstrates an industrial serving architecture.

name: Mooncake
problem_solved: KV cache movement and reuse are major bottlenecks in disaggregated LLM serving.
what_it_does: Provides Moonshot AI/Kimi serving components focused on KV-cache-centric disaggregated serving through Transfer Engine and Mooncake Store.
sample_project: Build a KV-cache reuse demo for repeated long-context workloads.
before_after_angle: Before: long prompts are recomputed on every request. After: a Mooncake-style cache store shows reuse.

name: BitNet.cpp
problem_solved: 1-bit and ternary LLMs need a dedicated efficient inference framework.
what_it_does: Provides the official inference framework inside Microsoft's BitNet repository for 1-bit LLM inference, benchmarking, and deployment.
sample_project: Run the BitNet b1.58 model on CPU and compare it with a normal quantized model.
before_after_angle: Before: a normal low-bit model is still memory-heavy. After: a 1-bit model has a much smaller memory footprint.

name: Feast
problem_solved: Real-time recommendation models often do not receive fresh user, item, and context features.
what_it_does: Open-source feature store for defining, managing, discovering and serving features.
sample_project: E-commerce recommender using recent views, cart additions and purchase features.
before_after_angle: Before: the model uses stale batch features. After: Feast online features enable real-time personalization.

name: FiftyOne
problem_solved: Visual AI teams need better dataset inspection, embeddings visualization, error analysis, and model-output comparison workflows.
what_it_does: Provides tools to visualize, label, curate, and evaluate visual datasets and model predictions.
sample_project: Analyze false positives and false negatives for a detector in an interactive UI.
before_after_angle: Before: errors are checked manually in folders. After: FiftyOne enables visual filtering and failure analysis.

name: LightlyTrain
problem_solved: Computer vision teams need a practical way to pretrain, fine-tune, and distill vision models on their own data.
what_it_does: Provides an all-in-one training framework for vision models including DINOv2/DINOv3, YOLO, RT-DETR, and transformer-based workflows.
sample_project: Pretrain or fine-tune a detector on a custom visual dataset and compare baseline versus adapted model behavior.
before_after_angle: Before: the model relies on generic pretrained weights. After: LightlyTrain adapts the vision model to domain-specific visual data.

name: MONAI
problem_solved: Medical imaging projects need domain-specific deep learning tools for training, inference, transforms, and evaluation.
what_it_does: Provides a PyTorch-based framework and ecosystem for deep learning workflows in healthcare imaging.
sample_project: Build a medical image segmentation experiment with MONAI transforms, training utilities, and sliding-window inference.
before_after_angle: Before: medical imaging pipelines require many custom utilities. After: MONAI provides domain-specific components for repeatable workflows.

name: Norfair
problem_solved: Object detection projects often need lightweight real-time tracking without rewriting a full tracking stack.
what_it_does: Provides a customizable Python library for real-time multi-object tracking that can work with detections from different detectors.
sample_project: Add tracking IDs to detections from a YOLO-style detector and evaluate object continuity across video frames.
before_after_angle: Before: detections are independent frame by frame. After: Norfair connects detections into tracked objects over time.

name: GEPA
problem_solved: Prompt and system optimization often requires expensive trial-and-error without interpretable traces.
what_it_does: Automatically optimizes prompts and AI system components using reflective prompt evolution, evaluation feedback, and adapters for systems such as DSPy, RAG, LangChain, and MCP.
sample_project: Optimize a RAG answer-generation prompt using a small validation set and compare baseline versus optimized outputs.
before_after_angle: Before: prompts are tuned manually. After: GEPA proposes and evaluates prompt candidates using feedback from system traces.

name: TextGrad
problem_solved: Text-based systems are hard to optimize with standard gradients, especially when they include prompts, agents, and tool calls.
what_it_does: Provides a PyTorch-like interface for text optimization using natural-language feedback as LLM gradients.
sample_project: Optimize a reasoning prompt or agent response pipeline with text-gradient feedback and compare answer quality before and after optimization.
before_after_angle: Before: prompt improvements are based on manual intuition. After: TextGrad uses structured natural-language feedback to guide iterative optimization.

name: ell
problem_solved: Prompt engineering becomes hard to track when prompts are treated as loose strings instead of versioned programs.
what_it_does: Provides a lightweight language model programming library that treats prompts as functions with versioning, tracing, evaluations, multimodal inputs, and a local studio.
sample_project: Build a versioned prompt workflow with traced calls, compare prompt versions, and inspect outputs in Ell Studio.
before_after_angle: Before: prompts are scattered across code with limited history. After: ell turns prompts into traceable, versioned language model programs.

name: Larq
problem_solved: Edge and mobile AI workloads need smaller, faster neural networks with lower memory and power requirements.
what_it_does: Provides an open-source ecosystem for building, training, and deploying Binarized Neural Networks with 1-bit weights and activations.
sample_project: Train a compact binarized image classifier and compare model size, latency, and accuracy against a standard TensorFlow/Keras baseline.
before_after_angle: Before: the model uses conventional 32/16/8-bit weights. After: Larq reduces memory and compute through binarized neural networks.

name: AIMET
problem_solved: Deep learning teams need a practical way to quantize models while tracking accuracy and latency tradeoffs.
what_it_does: Provides quantization simulation, post-training quantization, quantization-aware training, mixed precision, and export workflows for PyTorch and ONNX models.
sample_project: Quantize a PyTorch or ONNX vision model with AIMET and compare accuracy, latency, and exported model behavior.
before_after_angle: Before: the model is accurate but heavy. After: AIMET helps find a quantization profile that preserves quality while improving deployment efficiency.

name: HQQ
problem_solved: Large models are expensive to deploy because memory requirements remain high even when inference is otherwise feasible.
what_it_does: Provides fast calibration-free Half-Quadratic Quantization for large models, including LLM and vision model workflows.
sample_project: Quantize a small open-source language model with HQQ and compare memory usage, throughput, and output quality against the original model.
before_after_angle: Before: the model requires high VRAM. After: HQQ compresses weights quickly without calibration data.

name: Brevitas
problem_solved: Teams targeting reduced-precision deployment need a way to model quantized hardware data paths during training.
what_it_does: Provides PyTorch building blocks for quantization-aware training and reduced-precision model development, including export paths for inference acceleration.
sample_project: Train a quantization-aware classifier with Brevitas and export it for an accelerated inference target.
before_after_angle: Before: quantization is handled after training. After: Brevitas models reduced precision behavior during training.

name: Metaflow
problem_solved: Real ML, AI, and data science projects need reproducible workflows, scaling, versioning, and production deployment without leaving Python.
what_it_does: Provides a workflow framework for building, managing, scaling, versioning, and deploying real-life ML, AI, and data science projects.
sample_project: Build a multi-step model training and evaluation workflow that runs locally first and can later scale to cloud compute.
before_after_angle: Before: experiments live in ad-hoc notebooks and scripts. After: Metaflow turns them into versioned, reproducible workflows.

name: MLServer
problem_solved: Production ML systems need a standard inference server for REST/gRPC serving, batching, multi-model hosting, and Kubernetes-native deployment.
what_it_does: Provides an open-source inference server for machine learning models with V2 Inference Protocol support, multi-model serving, adaptive batching, and multiple runtimes.
sample_project: Serve a scikit-learn or Hugging Face model with MLServer and test REST/gRPC inference plus multi-model loading behavior.
before_after_angle: Before: model serving is a custom API wrapper. After: MLServer provides a standard production inference server.

name: Ragas
problem_solved: RAG, prompt, and agent workflows need repeatable evaluation metrics, test datasets, and improvement loops.
what_it_does: Provides evaluation tooling for RAG systems, prompts, agents, testset generation, metrics, and systematic optimization workflows.
sample_project: Evaluate a RAG pipeline with faithfulness, context relevance, and answer quality metrics, then compare baseline versus improved retrieval settings.
before_after_angle: Before: RAG quality is judged manually. After: Ragas provides repeatable evaluation metrics and improvement loops.
